name: Gillian Seed
source:
Age: 31 (estimated)

Having lost his memory three years ago, his past is enshrouded in mystery. He is currently separated from his wife, Jamie Seed. After undergoing training by the Special Forces, he recently joined the Junker Agency as a "runner" in hopes that exposure to Snatchers would spark his memory.

Note: His identity and that of his wife were determined only by the personal possessions discovered with him. His memory shows no sign of returning.

[From [url=http://www.justinaaron.com/thekremlin/gseed.html]The Kremlin[/url]]
